upstream_sync.notes: Adapts deterministic CLI + protected-node guard + online SQLite backup patterns to Markbridge's Rust-owned storage boundary.

intent.description: Operate Markbridge (签桥) isolated local Skills bookmark library (`local-skills` / `Skills 书签`) in SQLite (`markbridge.sqlite`) through `scripts/mb_bookmarks.py` and the Rust `markbridge-skill` CLI. Use when the user asks to save/add a URL or article to Markbridge bookmarks, create or organize local bookmark folders, list or search saved bookmarks (including FTS5 trigram notes/summaries), manage local tags/notes/summaries, or backup/export the local Skills bookmark library (存书签、收藏链接到签桥、 管理本地书签专夹、新建书签目录、搜索收藏、给书签打标签/记笔记/写摘要、备份导出本地书签数据库). Do NOT use for editing Chrome's `Bookmarks` file directly, pairing or debugging the Chrome MV3 extension, mutating Chrome-synced profiles via `chrome.bookmarks`, Firefox/Safari bookmarks, or app packaging.
intent.job_to_be_done: Operate Markbridge's isolated local Skills bookmark library (`local-skills` / `skills-root`) directly in SQLite via the Rust `markbridge-skill` CLI without touching Chrome or MV3 extension pairing.
target_users: AI coding agents operating inside the Markbridge repository
inputs: Bookmark URLs (http/https), titles, folder names, tags, notes, and summaries
Search queries, tag filters, and folder scopes
Optional --app-data isolation directory or explicit --allow-daily-db confirmation
outputs: Deterministic camelCase JSON envelopes from markbridge-skill
Consistent SQLite online backups and Netscape HTML / sidecar JSON exports
Live-reloaded bookmark state in a running Markbridge desktop window
exclusions: Directly reading or mutating Chrome Bookmarks JSON files
Chrome MV3 extension pairing, WebSocket troubleshooting, or mutating paired Chrome profiles
Calling system sqlite3 or Python sqlite3 directly against markbridge.sqlite
Publishing external installers or GitHub Releases

router_rules: **Route IN** when the user wants to collect/save URLs (`http://` or `https://`), create nested folders, move/update/delete items, tag bookmarks, attach notes or summaries, search saved bookmarks, or backup/export the local `Skills 书签库` inside Markbridge.

**Route OUT** when the user asks to read/write Chrome's raw `Bookmarks` file, pair or troubleshoot the Chrome MV3 extension (`chrome.bookmarks` / WebSocket), modify bookmarks inside a Chrome-synced profile, or build/install NSIS packages.

**Rust-only SQLite writer**: Always invoke `python .agents/skills/qiaomu-markbridge-bookmarks/scripts/mb_bookmarks.py ...`. **Never** open or mutate `markbridge.sqlite` with `sqlite3` CLI or Python's `sqlite3` module (bypasses `rusqlite` bundled FTS5 `trigram` tokenizer, semantic invalidation triggers, and DTO invariants).

**Daily DB write gate**: Reads (`status`, `tree`, `list`, `search`, `get`, `tag list`, `export`) work on the daily database by default. Writes to the daily `%APPDATA%\com.markbridge.desktop\markbridge.sqlite` require explicit `--allow-daily-db` **only when the user actually asked to modify their Markbridge bookmark library**; automated tests, demos, and rehearsals MUST pass `--app-data <ABS_TEMP_DIR>`.
**Destructive folder deletes**: Deleting a non-empty folder requires `--recursive` AND an online SQLite snapshot `--backup <ABS_BACKUP_FILE>` before execution.
compact_workflow: **Inspect status first**: Run `python .agents/skills/qiaomu-markbridge-bookmarks/scripts/mb_bookmarks.py status` (with `--app-data <ABS_DIR>` for isolated runs) to check `exists`, `schemaVersion`, `revision`, `folderCount`, and `bookmarkCount`.

**Initialize lazily when needed**: If `exists` is `false` and the user wants to create folders or save bookmarks in `Skills 书签库`, run `init` (with `--allow-daily-db` for the real app DB, or `--app-data <ABS_DIR>` for isolated DBs) or proceed directly to `mkdir` / `add` (both auto-provision `local-skills` + `skills-root` idempotently).

**Resolve target folder**: Use `tree` or `list` to check existing folders under `skills-root` (`Skills 书签`) before creating duplicate folders; create missing sub-folders via `mkdir --title "<NAME>" [--parent <FOLDER_ID>]`.
Save bookmark + sidecars in one call: `add --title "<TITLE>" --url "<HTTPS_URL>" [--parent <FOLDER_ID>] [--tags "tag1,tag2"] [--note "<NOTE>"] [--summary "<SUMMARY>"]`
Search bookmarks (title, URL, tags, and FTS5 trigram note/summary): `search --query "<KEYWORD>" [--tags "tag1"] [--folder <FOLDER_ID>]`

**Backup before destructive changes**: Before `delete --recursive` or bulk reorganization, pass `--backup <ABS_SQLITE_BACKUP_PATH>` (uses `rusqlite::backup` online WAL-safe snapshot) or run `backup --output <ABS_PATH>`.

**Report structured receipt**: Parse the single-line/pretty JSON stdout (`ok`, `revision`, `result`) and report affected node IDs, folder path, tags, and new `revision` (which any running Markbridge desktop window picks up automatically within ~120ms).
gate_ladder: **Boundary & Redaction Gate**: Reject non-`http(s)` URLs, URLs with embedded credentials (`user:pass@host`), mutations targeting non-`local-skills` profiles (`WRONG_PROFILE`), and mutations targeting protected root `skills-root` (`PROTECTED_NODE`). Never print raw filesystem paths in error envelopes.
**Daily Database Protection Gate**: Any write command targeting a path containing `com.markbridge.desktop` without `--allow-daily-db` exits with code `2` and `errorCode: "READ_ONLY"`.

**Deterministic Execution Gate**: `python .agents/skills/qiaomu-markbridge-bookmarks/scripts/mb_bookmarks.py --self-test` and `python -m unittest discover -s .agents/skills/qiaomu-markbridge-bookmarks/tests -p "test_*.py"` must pass 100% in disposable temp directories.
**Governance & Package Gate**: Pass `validate_skill.py` (zero warnings), `trigger_eval.py` (100% pass), `export_skill_ir.py`, and `release_check.py --phase local --run-tests`.
output_contract: **CLI / Script Stdout**: Always valid UTF-8 JSON with `"ok": true` (plus command payload & `revision`) on exit code `0`, or `{"ok": false, "errorCode": "<SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE>", "message": "<redacted summary>"}` on exit code `1` (storage/migration failure) or `2` (validation/policy refusal).

**Agent Reply to User**: Concisely report the action taken in `Skills 书签库` (`local-skills`), created/updated node title & `chromeId`, folder location, applied tags/note/summary, and current `revision` (noting that if Markbridge desktop is open, switching the top-left source selector to `Skills 书签库（本地库）` shows the update immediately; if first-time enabled from empty state, click `设置 -> 连接 -> 启用本地 Skills 书签库` or reopen).

filesystem_read: Markbridge workspace Cargo.toml and target/markbridge-skill binary
filesystem_write: Daily com.markbridge.desktop/markbridge.sqlite ONLY when --allow-daily-db is explicitly passed

degradation.missing_prebuilt_binary: Automatically runs cargo build --quiet -p markbridge-skill-cli --bin markbridge-skill
degradation.uninitialized_local_space: Lazily provisions local-skills and protected root skills-root on init, mkdir, or add
